probe: 16 stratified relchem; 8 AE17; 8 grid-size-stratified mRKS, shared Exc/op
probe_weighting: Canonical population stratum size / task population / sampled stratum count
bootstrap: 5000 paired within-stratum resamples; seed931002; limited coverage is not exact qualification

screening.eligible: Finite 20-update trajectory, relchem probe ratio<=1.05, every probe ratio<=1.25, at least one ratio<1, no persistent destructive flag
screening.persistent_destructive: A task has negative actual-step progress in >=8 of last10 updates AND its probe ratio>1.10
screening.ranking: Relchem improvement first; lower relchem ratio; more improved tasks; lower maximum ratio; lower LR

endpoint: Reuse exact t0; selected arms exact251x8/17x8/full90 before any clean28 evaluation
